IASNLP 2026

14th IIIT Advanced Summer School on Natural Language Processing

12th - 27th June 2026
LTRC, IIIT Hyderabad

  • LTRC, IIIT-H invites applications for IASNLP 2026.

  • The theme of this year is Speech LLMs – Unified Speech and Language Intelligence.

  • 2-day Pre-School session from 12th to 13th June 2026.

  • Deadline for application: 30th April 2026

About

LTRC, IIIT-H announces the 14th edition of Summer School Series, IASNLP 2026, an opportunity for those passionate about advancing their knowledge in Speech Large Language Models (Speech LLMs).

Speech LLMs represent the evolution of AI systems that unify speech and language understanding within a single framework. Unlike traditional pipelines that separate Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech LLMs aim to process and generate spoken language end-to-end.

These models combine advances in large language models, self-supervised speech representations, and multimodal learning to enable systems that can listen, reason, and respond directly in speech. Applications include conversational AI, speech-to-speech translation, voice assistants, and accessibility technologies.

Programme

This summer school is designed to provide a strong foundation in speech and language technologies, with a focus on Speech Large Language Models (Speech LLMs). The programme combines expert lectures, hands-on sessions, and guided projects to bridge fundamental concepts with current research trends.

Participants will gain both theoretical understanding and practical experience in building speech-enabled AI systems, working closely with mentors and engaging with real-world problems in speech and language processing.

Objectives:

  • Introduce core concepts in speech processing and large language models
  • Provide exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Speech LLMs and emerging research directions
  • Enable participants to build and experiment with speech and language technologies
  • Offer hands-on experience with modern toolkits, datasets, and pipelines
  • Facilitate interaction with academic researchers and industry experts

Target Participants:

  • Undergraduate and postgraduate students
  • Research scholars
  • Faculty members
  • Industry professionals
  • Anyone interested in speech and AI systems

What You Will Gain:

  • Develop working knowledge of speech and language modeling techniques
  • Understanding LLMs and Speech LLMs.
  • Build confidence in implementing real-world speech and language technologies
  • Understand datasets, evaluation strategies, and deployment challenges

Pre-School Session: Do you feel you lack the basics or background in speech, NLP, linguistics, or programming? Don’t worry — this pre-school is designed to bridge these gaps and bring everyone to a common starting point.

Through carefully structured sessions, participants will be introduced to essential concepts in machine learning, speech processing, and programming, ensuring they are well-prepared to make the most of the summer school.

The 2-day Pre-School session will be held from 12th to 13th June 2026. This is covered as part of the registration fee.

Topics & Lectures

Speech Technologies

Understand State-of-the-art automatic speech recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis, and Multilingual ASR & TTS systems.

NLU and NLG

Understand Large Language Models (LLMs), including transformers, pretraining, fine-tuning, reasoning, and conversational AI systems.

Speech LLMs

Explore unified models that jointly process speech and text, enabling speech-to-speech interaction, multimodal reasoning, and conversational AI systems built directly over audio.

Applications

Learn about Speech-Speech Machine Translation systems, Conversational AI and voice assistants.

Who can Apply?

  • Undergraduate (final-year), master's, and PhD students in Computer Science, ECE, Linguistics, Cognitive Science and related disciplines.

  • Post-doctoral researchers and faculty members exploring speech, text, and multimodal AI.

  • Industry professionals interested in and working in NLP, speech processing, and AI-driven applications.

They would be able to work on research projects during the summer school and can continue even after it is over.

How To Apply?

Interested participants can apply by filling out the Application Form. Selected candidates will be notified via email.

Note: Upon acceptance into the summer school, participants will need to pay a non-refundable registration fee to confirm their participation

Registration Details:

  • The registration fee covers participation in all programme activities, including lectures, hands-on sessions, and project work.
  • Lunch will be provided on the main summer school days.
  • Accommodation (hostel rooms on a sharing basis) is chargeable and not included in the registration fee.
  • Application is open to all. Selected candidates will be eligible to register.
  • Registration is non-transferable.

Certification & Awards:

  • Participants who successfully complete the programme requirements (attendance and project work) will receive an e-certificate of completion.
  • Merit certificates will be awarded to participants of the top 3 projects.

Financial Support: In special and deserving cases, financial support may be provided to cover the registration fee. This will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please write to iasnlp@iiit.ac.in to apply.

FAQs

Application related FAQs

1. Is there an application fee?

No, there is no application fee. However, if you are accepted, you will need to pay a registration fee as per your category (Student, Faculty, or Industry Professional).

2. Can I edit my application after submitting it?

No, once submitted, the application cannot be edited. Please review all your information carefully before submitting.

3. How will I know if my application is successfully submitted?

After submission, you will receive a confirmation message on the screen. You may also receive a confirmation email.

4. When will I be notified about the application status?

You will be notified via email by May 10, 2026.

5. Can I apply if I do not have prior experience in NLP or Speech Processing?

Yes, applicants from various backgrounds are welcome. The Pre-School Session (June 12-13, 2026) is designed to introduce essential tools and concepts to beginners.

6. Can industry professionals apply?

Yes, industry professionals are encouraged to apply if they have a relevant background or interest in NLP, Speech Processing, and AI-driven applications.

7. What criteria will be used to select participants?

Selection will be based on:

  • Relevance of academic or professional background.
  • Project experience in NLP or Speech Processing (if any).
  • Statement of purpose and motivation to attend the summer school.

8. What should I do if I have technical issues while submitting the application?

If you encounter any issues, please contact iasnlp@iiit.ac.in with details about the problem.

9. Can I apply if I am from a non-technical background?

Yes, participants from Cognitive Science, Linguistics, or related interdisciplinary fields are encouraged to apply. The Pre-School Session will cover foundational tools and concepts.

10. What happens if I miss the application deadline?

Late applications will not be accepted. Make sure to submit your application before April 30th, 2026.

11. What happens after I submit my application?

After submission, your application will be reviewed by the organizing committee. If selected, you will receive a notification email by May 10, 2026, with further instructions for registration and fee payment.

12. How will I be informed about the acceptance of my application?

You will be notified via email by May 10, 2026. Ensure you check your inbox regularly, including the spam/junk folder.

13. Which year of undergraduate students are eligible to apply?

Pre-final year students who are about to enter their final year, as well as final-year students who are about to graduate, are eligible to apply.

14. Can I reapply if my application is not accepted?

Unfortunately, you cannot reapply for IASNLP 2026 if your application is rejected. However, you are welcome to apply in future editions of the program.

Summer School related FAQs

1. Is IASNLP 2026 conducted online or offline?

IASNLP 2026 is an offline event and will be held at IIIT Hyderabad, India.

2. Will I receive reimbursement for travel, accommodation, and food expenses?

No, reimbursement for travel, accommodation, and food expenses is not provided. Participants must make their own arrangements for travel, stay, and food during the summer school. However, affordable food options will be available on campus.

3. Can I attend only a part of the summer school and still receive a certificate?

No, full attendance is mandatory to receive a certificate. You must be present for the entire duration of the summer school (June 12 - June 27, 2026).

4. Can I attend only the lectures and skip the project work?

No, participation in both lectures and the project work is mandatory. The project component is crucial to the learning experience and assessment.

5. Do I need to bring a laptop?

Yes, you must bring your own laptop. It will be essential for hands-on sessions and project work throughout the summer school.

6. Are medical services available on campus?

Yes, basic medical facilities are available on campus. Additionally, multi-specialty hospitals are located nearby for emergencies or specialized medical care.

7. What identification documents do I need to bring?

You must bring your institution-issued ID card, which will be required for physical registration at the event.

8. Is attendance at the Pre-School Session (June 12th and 13th) mandatory?

No, attendance at the Pre-School Session is optional. It is designed for participants who are new to linguistics, speech processing, or programming. However, it is highly recommended if you lack background knowledge in these areas.

9. Will there be internet access on campus?

Yes, participants will have access to campus Wi-Fi. Login credentials will be provided during registration.

10. Will I work individually or in a team for the project?

You will work in a team for the project. Collaboration and teamwork are essential aspects of the learning process at IASNLP 2026.

11. Will certificates be provided?

Yes, certificates of completion will be provided to participants who attend the entire summer school and successfully complete the project work.

12. Is online or hybrid participation available for the summer school?

No, the summer school will be conducted entirely in person at IIIT-Hyderabad. Online, remote, or hybrid participation modes will not be available.

13. Is accommodation available at IIIT-H?

Yes, hostel accommodation at IIIT-H is available on a sharing basis. The hostel fee for the complete stay is Rs. 5513/-. Participants may also explore nearby accommodation options such as:

  • Aditya Inn
  • Treebo Kruthika Residency
  • TRUNK AND TROLLEY

14. Will food be provided during the summer school?

Lunch will be provided during the summer school from 15th–27th June 2026. Other meals can be purchased from the IIIT-H mess and canteens.

15. What should I prepare before attending the summer school?

Make sure you bring your laptop, institution-issued ID card, and any necessary tools or software installations as instructed. Familiarity with basic NLP concepts will be helpful.
